The logo: R2 in every title face

Holger, 29 Sep: R2 (World of out to the G, on Card Games’ circle) in all 38 title faces of the frontpage mockup’s font menu, side by side and above and below, then the same with both lines in capitals. Card Games in the menu’s cut, World of one weight up where the family has one here. The numbers follow the menu’s order, with Gelica 500 (R2, number 22) first. Then 27 sans faces the same two ways, classic and friendly, some condensed, at Holger’s word the same evening.

Serif, mixed caseSerif, capitalsSans, mixed caseSans, capitals

Sans, mixed case

Holger, 29 Sep: a bunch of interesting non-serif faces, classic and friendly or fun, some condensed, to see if that gives a different expression. The classics first (Futura, Gill Sans, Avenir Next, Helvetica Neue Condensed from the Mac; Jost and Josefin Sans), then the condensed ones, then the rounded and the fun ones.
